For those who hunt for high quality sound (Audiophiles), the line of earbuds Sennheiser Momentum True Wireless 4 is always the top choice. This latest generation is upgraded with the Qualcomm S5 audio processing chip system and future technology Auracast Share spatial audio.

Sennheiser's sound quality is extremely unique with a solid, well-bouncing bass range and a sweet mid range that honors the singer's voice. The new generation Hybrid ANC adaptive noise canceling system continuously measures noise to adjust the cancellation frequency smoothly, without causing ear pain or headaches.
